steps.text: Before you begin, ensure that you have enough prayer points to use Protect from Melee for around five seconds (you will need this later in the temple). Talk to Lazim in the quarry south of the Bandit Camp.
Get 32kg of sandstone and give it to Lazim. This can be done in batches, and you can mine some nearby.
choices: Okay, I'll get on with it.

steps.text: Use a chisel on the sandstone 32kg.
Place the base on the flat ground nearby.
Talk to Lazim again.
Get 20kg of sandstone and give it to Lazim. This can be done in batches, and you can mine some nearby.
Use a chisel on the sandstone 20kg.
Place the body on the sandstone base.
Talk to Lazim and choose the head you'd like the statue to have.
Get 2 x granite (5kg). You can mine some nearby.
Use a chisel on a piece of granite 5kg, and choose the head you decided on to craft.
Use a chisel on the headless statue.
Give Lazim the head.
Enter the temple south of the Bandit's Camp.
Enter the temple south of the Bandit's Camp.
Talk to Lazim in the temple.
Use a chisel on the fallen statue to get all its limbs.
Take the M sigil from the pedestal in the room.
Take the Z sigil from the pedestal in the north room.
Take the K sigil from the pedestal in the west room.
Take the R sigil from the pedestal in the south room.
Talk to Lazim in the temple for the stone head.
choices: Do you know where the statue's head is?

steps.text: Enter the right arm door.
Enter the left leg door.
Enter the left arm door.
Enter the right leg door.
Enter the door with a K.
Enter the door with an R.
Enter the door with an M.
Enter the door with a Z.
Open the central room's doors using the metal letters. Go up the ladder in the central room.
Use soft clay on the pedestal.
Use a chisel on granite (5kg).
Use the camel stone head on the pedestal.
Right-click use bread or cake on Pentyn.
Cast a fire spell on the frozen fountain.
Cast an air spell on the furnace.
Use a normal log on the south west brazier.
Use an oak log on the south brazier.
Use a willow log on the south east brazier.
Use a maple log on the north west brazier.
Use a candle on the north brazier.
Use coal on the north east brazier.
Pass through the magic barrier and go up the ladder.
Go up the ladder.
Cast crumble undead on the Boneguard. Make sure you take off any armour or weapons which give you a negative magic attack bonus or else you might splash.
Climb down the stone ladder past the Boneguard.
Put on Protect from Melee, then talk to the Boneguard.
Take sandstone from the nearby rubble, and use it to repair the south wall. For each piece added, use a chisel on the wall.
choices: Of course, I'll help you out.

steps.text: Use a chisel on the wall.
choices: Of course, I'll help you out.

steps.text: Talk to the Boneguard to finish the quest.
